bibl.title: Śṛṅgāratilakabhāṇa
Śṛṅgārataraṅgiṇī?
bibl.note: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
Descriptive Catalogue of Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Adyar Library (Adyar). Vols. 1–13.
Thiruvengadathan, A. Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and His Works: A Study. Chennai: The Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, 2002.
Sastri, T. S. Kuppuswami Sastri. ‘Ramabhadra-Dikshita and the Southern Poets of his Time.’ Indian Antiquary, Vol. XXXIII, pp. 126-142 and pp. 176-196, 2004.
Lists of Sanskrit Manuscripts in Private Libraries of Southern India (Oppert). Vols 1–2

Madura is mentioned as the venue of enactment. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 41.

Written at the request of Raghunātha, his disciple. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 42; Sastri, T. S. Kuppuswami Sastri. ‘Ramabhadra-Dikshita and the Southern Poets of his Time.’ Indian Antiquary, Vol. XXXIII, pp. 126-142 and pp. 176-196, 2004: p. 178; and Thiruvengadathan, A. Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and His Works: A Study. Chennai: The Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, 2002: p. 16.

Oppert lists Śṛṅgārataraṅgiṇī as a bhāṇa in Lists of Sanskrit Manuscripts in Private Libraries of Southern India (Oppert). Vols 1–2: vol. 2, p. 251, ms. 3849. And New Catalogus Catalogurum (NCC). Vols 1-36: vol. 35, p. 91b lists 'cf. Śṛṅgāratilakabhāṇa' under Śṛṅgārataraṅgiṇī.
